name: Harley-Davidson
outlook:
What Harley-Davidson says to expect

  • Full year 2026: motorcycle sales and operating incomeFor the full year 2026, the Company is raising HDMC and HDFS financial guidance and now expects: • HDMC: ◦ Global Motorcycle Retail Sales of 135,500 to 139,000 units ◦ Global Motorcycle Wholesale Shipments of 135,500 to 139,000 units ◦ Operating income of $25 to $55 million
The company's own words, from its earnings release (Form 8-K, Exhibit 99), filed October 29, 2026. They are its expectations, not ours, and not a forecast or price target from The Filing Desk. Replaced when the next release is out.
